_format.competitor_pool: uuid -> resolved SingleCompetitorCard {competitor, roster_name, division, ten_stat (the skill rated 10), stats}. Reference source of card facts.
_format.matchups[]: {tournament_round, team_a, team_b, games:[{pairing:'round'(slot vs slot)|'ten_stat', key, a:{player,competitor,db_uuid,ten_stat,slot}, b:{...}|null if no partner}]}
